description: Transvaalbuurt 1908-1914 speculative rows, tall-ground variant (Transvaalstraat 3-47, Retiefstraat 3-41): the design of transvaal-1911-five-storey with a 4.05 m ground storey and 3.3 m upper storeys under a light cornice at 14.2-15.0 m, taller upper windows (2.1-2.4 m), the balcony axis on storeys 1-3; white pointed timber dormers (Transvaalstraat) or brick wall dormers and pointed gables (Retiefstraat 3-41) over the cornice

match.note: Cornice line 12.8-14.3 m on the strips (Retiefstraat 45-75 12.8, Pretoriusstraat 72-120 13.4, Transvaalstraat 3-47 14.0-14.3), gable and dormer tops 15.5-16.7 m. The strip skyline is no guide on these rows: it reads the dormer, gable and chimney tops or the street trees at 15.5-18.4 m (Retiefstraat 3-75, Transvaalstraat 25-45), so the eaves criterion is 3DBAG: 12-16.6 m on the family (the gables on some pands, 15.5-16.2 m on Retiefstraat 47-67 and Transvaalstraat 7-19) at the type pitch of 4 storeys, and 3DBAG bouwlagen 5 (234 of 276 pands; the attic counts). 3DBAG roof rise reads 0-0.1 m (flat) over the pitched tile roofs: no roof criterion. BAG 1908-1914 on all 37 photographed faces. The 8.5 m Retiefstraat 3-41 fronts keep three wide axes. No balcony veto (the type has them). Crown by the skyline: a narrow-topped tall crown is a pointed gable (Retiefstraat 45-75, Pretoriusstraat 72-120), a 1-2.8 m flat top a brick wall dormer (Retiefstraat 3-41, 45-51), a small low crown a white timber dormer (Transvaalstraat 3-47, Majubastraat 1-151). Two variants of one design that facts cannot tell apart (3DBAG eaves and bouwlagen agree): this one has the 4.0 m ground storey (heads 6.7, 9.9-10.0, 13.1-13.5 m, cornice 14.2-15.0 m), transvaal-1911-five-storey the low 3.35 m one (heads 5.7-6.0, 8.9-9.2, 11.9-12.5 m, cornice 13.3-13.5 m); run auto-place with --photo-decides

point-gable.note: Retiefstraat 53-75 (154435 136245 092019), Pretoriusstraat 80-96 (102414 149642 142310): a pointed brick gable the width of the front, top 15.5-16.5 m (rise 2.5-3 m over the cornice), one attic light

wall-dormer.note: Retiefstraat 45-51 (068243 123300), Retiefstraat 3-41 (068730 081061): a brick wall dormer over the centre axis, about 1.8 m wide, rising 2.3-2.6 m over the cornice, one light, flat cap

dormer.note: Transvaalstraat 21-41 (072312 084571 149583 108858): one white timber dormer with a pointed cap over the cornice, 1.2-1.6 m wide, top 16.0-16.7 m

door-left.note: the house door (round-arched on Retiefstraat 45-75) on the left axis; mirrored when the strip reads it on the right

rhythm.bays: window, balcony door, window at 5.5-6.3 m; two axes at 5 m; four at 6.4-7.6 m (window, balcony door, two windows: Pretoriusstraat 72-120 and 71-95); three wide axes on the 8.5 m double fronts, four at 10.8 m
rhythm.identicalBays: near: the centre balcony door is a little narrower
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: door + windows | 1-3: window + balcony door + window
rhythm.symmetry: near symmetric; the door side alternates along the row
rhythm.groundFloor: house door on an outer axis, windows or a shop
rhythm.signage: shops on Pretoriusstraat and Transvaalstraat corners
rhythm.roofline: a light simple cornice; a pointed gable, a brick wall dormer or a white dormer over it

schemaLimits: the segmental brick relieving arches over the Transvaalstraat windows and the arched balcony windows of Retiefstraat 3-41 are flat heads
Retiefstraat 3-41 axes are of three widths (2.5, 2.0 and a narrow pair); drawn as three equal bays
the 10 m Transvaalstraat 7-19 double fronts (two houses under one BAG pand, two dormers) are one module with four axes and one dormer
notes: Palette: the type default is a mid dark red-brown; every placed pand takes its trim-normalised strip wall (auto-place measuredPalette).

Retiefstraat 45-75 sheet (2026-10-31): every window has a white stone lintel block and sill (windowSurround stone-lintel); the roof face behind the cornice is orange-red tile (Retiefstraat 45-75, Transvaalstraat 74-104)

Pretoriusstraat 71-95 and 72-120 sheets (2026-10-31): the 6.8-7.1 m fronts carry four axes, the balcony on the second from the door side; strip storey heights (measureFacade storeyM) read 2.9-3.1 m on Retiefstraat 45-75, 3.1-3.3 m on Transvaalstraat 3-47 and Retiefstraat 3-41, 3.2-3.5 m on Pretoriusstraat: they do not separate the low- and tall-ground twins (the ground storey does), so the photo decides
